## Summary

Motion accessibility guardrails and Kanban state coverage (PSI-112). CODE: (1) Added shared motion-safe.ts token helper collapsing staggers, fades, tap/hover physics, and transitions to static under prefers-reduced-motion; wired useReducedMotion() into animated-number, live-pulse (infinite halo now static), animated-stats-grid, animated-charts-grid, task-card, daily-digest-card, tour-modal (progress bar and step dots now transform-only scaleX instead of width), and ai-chat-interface. (2) Replaced Kanban height-based accordion with grid-template-rows collapse (transform/opacity only). (3) Added KanbanBoardSkeleton (shape-matching loader), KanbanBoardEmptyState / KanbanColumnEmptyState (composed empty states), and KanbanBoardErrorState with retry in kanban-board/board-column. (4) Unit tests: motion-safe.test.ts (reduced-motion branches) and kanban-state.test.ts. 130 frontend tests and 22 edge function tests pass; typecheck and oxlint clean.
